context.problem: Every route-level JS file (under public/assets/js/routes/**/) re-declares the same ~150-line boilerplate block verbatim: - ensureToastContainer(containerId) - showErrorNow(message) - scheduleInteractiveError(msg) / schedulePointerupError(msg) - getMsg(el, key) — full locale-lookup logic - verifyRoute(candidate) - getToken() This causes ~60 KB of dead duplication across 1 100+ route files.
context.solution: Build three singleton files (ERPGuard, ERPUtils, ERPBootstrap) loaded by the main Blade layouts. Each route file then gets a one-liner bootstrap call and delegates to guard.* instead of re-implementing the logic.
context.retrocompatibility: All filesystem paths MUST remain unchanged. Namespace modules that expose a public API (e.g. ContractHelpers) MUST preserve every exported symbol — only their implementations are delegated inward.

requiredMethods.method: safeFetch(url, opts) — fetch + JSON + error normalisation
ajaxPost(url, data, opts) — thin wrapper over safeFetch
ajaxDelete(url, opts) — thin wrapper over safeFetch

file.note: No modifications required by this refactor; it already exists.

api.method: ERPBootstrap.register(key, factory) — factory() must return the singleton instance
ERPBootstrap.require(...keys) → Object — returns { guard, utils, … } with camelCase keys — warns but does NOT throw when a singleton is missing
ERPBootstrap.ensureSingletons() — initialises all registered factories that have not yet run

file.minify: Produce erp-bootstrap.min.js alongside the source. Command: npx terser erp-bootstrap.js -o erp-bootstrap.min.js --compress --mangle

bladeLayouts.rule: Add ONE script tag loading erp-bootstrap.min.js in each master layout, placed BEFORE any deferred route script tags but AFTER core dependency scripts (jQuery, Bootstrap JS).

heavy.description: Full boilerplate re-implementations — all 4 functions present

medium.description: Only getMsg + locale logic without toast boilerplate

light.description: Only destructuring from singletons — no actual re-implementation
light.note: These files are already clean; skip them.

namespaceModules.description: Exports a public window.* API consumed by other scripts
namespaceModules.rule: MUST NOT use the automated batch script. See section 7.

steps.step: Brace-counting scanner: locate any of the following top-level const declarations and remove the entire block (declaration + body): ensureToastContainer, showErrorNow, scheduleInteractiveError, schedulePointerupError, getMsg, verifyRoute, getToken
Remove any line matching: const { getMsg, showErrorNow, … } = window.ERPGuard … const guard = window.ERPGuard.getInstance() that existed in the original file before this refactor.

Apply the following call-site substitutions (regex, whole-word): getMsg(el, key) → guard.getMsg(key) getMsg(_, key) → guard.getMsg(key) showErrorNow(…) → guard.error(…) scheduleInteractiveError(…) → guard.scheduleInteractiveError(…) schedulePointerupError(…) → guard.scheduleInteractiveError(…) !ensureJq() → !(window.jQuery && window.jQuery.fn) verifyRoute(x) → !guard.isInvalidUrl(x) getToken() → guard.getCsrfToken() CAUTION: !ensureJq() becomes !(…) not !!!(…) — verify after sed.
Remove const DATA_* = "data-*" lines that are no longer referenced after the function blocks have been stripped.

batchScript.artifactFix: After running the script, check for triple-negation artifacts: grep -rn "!!!(" public/assets/js/routes/ Fix with: sed -i 's/!!!(window\.jQuery/!(window.jQuery/g' <file> Affected files (2026-02): leads/order.js, zoomMeetings/calendar.js, zoomMeetings/actions.js, contracts/note,js

namespaceModuleRefactor.description: Files that export a public namespace (e.g. window.ContractHelpers) must preserve every exported symbol in the exact same shape. Only the internal implementation is delegated to guard.*.
namespaceModuleRefactor.rule: Add ERPBootstrap.require at module top (after "use strict").
Replace function bodies — keep signatures identical.
Do NOT remove any key from the exported namespace object.
Provide a null/alert fallback for every guard.* call in case ERPBootstrap itself is unavailable (degraded environment).
namespaceModuleRefactor.uniqueFunctions: Keep these implementations intact — they have no guard equivalent: ensureJQuery(onError), ensureDropzone(onError), isLocalhost(), guardAnchor(anchor, useDataUrl), guardFormAction(sel, anchorSel), createBoundHandler(bindAttr, setup, cleanup)

verification.check: No orphan ensureToastContainer calls: grep -rn "ensureToastContainer(" public/assets/js/routes/ | grep -v "function ensureToastContainer"

Blade literals intact in Blade-embedded JS files: grep -c "{{" public/assets/js/routes/tasks/drag.js (expect ≥ 21) grep -c "{{" public/assets/js/routes/leads/order.js (expect ≥ 2) grep -c "{{" public/assets/js/routes/zoomMeetings/calendar.js (expect ≥ 3)

ContractHelpers public API intact: node -e "require('./public/assets/js/routes/contracts/shared/helpers.js')" 2>&1 | grep -v "window is not defined" Alternatively: grep "global.ContractHelpers = {" … and count exported keys.
Git diff byte reduction ≥ 2000 deletions across route files.

instructions.commitMessage:
feat(js): singleton bootstrap architecture + refactor N route files
- ERPGuard: add getCsrfToken, resolveUrl, safeFetch, ajaxPost, ajaxDelete, guardedAjax methods - ERPBootstrap: new singleton registry & loader (erp-bootstrap.js/min.js) with require(), register(), ensureSingletons() API - Blade layouts: load erp-bootstrap.min.js in admin, auth, landing - Route files: remove ~2,500 lines of duplicated boilerplate from N files (ensureToastContainer, showErrorNow, scheduleInteractiveError, getMsg, verifyRoute), replaced with ERPBootstrap.require + guard.* delegates - <namespace module>: manually refactored as thin wrapper preserving public API for backward compatibility - All Blade template literals (route macros, translations) preserved
